mentions.title: King bearings problem
mentions.snippet: Newly surfaced Moparts thread titled as a King bearings problem. No date and no snippet text were available from the search result, so the nature and severity of the complaint are unknown beyond the title.

mentions.title: King Main Bearings Defective
mentions.snippet: Poster reports King STDX main bearings whose thrust bearings were over 1mm too narrow to fit both BMW S85 and S65 blocks, and concludes King main bearings should not be used on those engines because getting something that fundamental wrong means the bearings cannot be trusted. Explicit buyer warning against a product line.
mentions.replyNote: Still 307-redirects to the tollbit.m5board.com mirror instead of returning thread content; redirect not followed.

mentions.title: WARNING!! Check all KING brand bearings before install
mentions.snippet: Thread titled as an outright warning telling builders to inspect every King-brand bearing before installation. A buyer-warning thread on a high-traffic BMW forum.

mentions.title: WARNING about King Main Thrust Bearings
mentions.snippet: Buyer-warning thread about King main thrust bearings on a diesel truck forum; re-read today and it is still open and unresolved, with the most recent post dated 3 June 2026 and no King reply.
mentions.replyNote: Readable today for the first time after months of 403s: no King or official reply, thread still open and unresolved, last post dated 3 June 2026.

mentions.title: King Bearings?
mentions.snippet: Long-running Speed-Talk thread in which a builder reports a 2024 King main bearing out of spec on free spread and a 2025 main bearing also bad, suggesting a manufacturing process problem. Other posters report no issues, so it is contested, but the out-of-spec claims are recent.
mentions.replyNote: Thread read successfully; still no King or official brand representative reply and it remains open and unresolved.

mentions.title: Just call it what it is---King Bearings are no longer an option....
mentions.snippet: Thread arguing King bearings are effectively no longer an option for 6-bolt DSM engines because of extended back-order status since the pandemic. Critical of availability rather than of a product fault.
